title: Final Report
description: Distinguishes surviving findings from refuted conjectures, unresolved alternatives, recommendations, evidence gaps, and limitations. Every factual finding must cite the surviving claim(s) it rests on.

findings.description: Factual sections built only from surviving claims. Each one must reference the surviving claim ID(s) it rests on.

surviving_claim_refs.description: IDs of the surviving claim(s) in the claim register that this finding rests on.

refuted_conjectures.description: Conjectures a test or review falsified during the run.

unresolved_alternatives.description: Alternative explanations neither confirmed nor ruled out.

recommendations.description: Actions recommended on the strength of the surviving findings.

evidence_gaps.description: Known gaps where evidence was insufficient to settle a claim.

limitations.description: Constraints on scope, method, or time that bound what this report can claim.
